experiments.paper_location: Section 4.3 SimHash table construction; maintained restriction of archived binary16 packing
experiments.mechanism: Reject unsupported K at maintained native LSH allocation before owner mutation; verify every accepted integer key/query code routes to its unique token across two collision tables.

conditions.execution: Actual maintained selected allocation/fastfill/retrieve/destructor bodies; contiguous host Torch metadata shim, no Torch runtime
conditions.oracle: Independent literal integer bits/powers reconstruct every code0..2^K-1; each code appears in both key tables and query coordinates and must retrieve exactly its token ID
conditions.boundary_policy: Real TORCH_CHECK rejects K outside1..11 before shifts, bucket count, member writes or allocation. Invalid calls on fresh and populated owners leave state reusable/unchanged. Valid allocation remains alloc-once.
conditions.archived_packing: Existing MAGICPIG-SIMHASH-CPU separately exhausts actual archived fill-packing AST for4094 codes at K1..11 and characterizes binary16 rounding at K12+; archive is unchanged

experiments.note: Deliberate maintained accepted-domain policy for Issue65, not integer-packing support at K>=12 or a new Python model port. The archived key/query packing remains historical and its outside-domain loss examples are retained. Actual CPU Torch confirmation awaits a maintained tensor integration; host metadata checks and integer tests do not establish Torch ABI, BF16 projection rounding or model generation. K/L/scaling policy of probability correction remains a separate Issue67.
